annotations.title: Say therfore.
annotations.text: Abraham concealed that Sarai was his wife, and lyed not in ſaying, ſhe was his ſiſter: as he alſo called Lot his brother, <mn>[1]</mn>being his brothers ſonne, and she his brothers daughter. VVherby he preuented danger of his owne life, vſing ſuch lawful meanes as lay in him, committing his wiues chaſtitie to Gods protection, which him ſelf could not prouide for. <mn>[2]</mn> In which caſe if he had not donne his owne endeuour, he had rather tempted God (ſaith S Auguſtin) <mn>[3]</mn> then truſted in God. And ſo God preſerued her, though she was in Pharao his houſe. v. 17.

notes.text: Men are bond to do their lawful endeuoures, and to commit the rest to God.
